evaluation_instructions: Run each prompt independently with SKILL.md. Verify that team-qa operates in its two streamlined modes (plan and verify), pre-fills automated/manual execution types for quick confirmation, imports JUnit/JSON or manual results accurately, and creates linked Jira Bugs via create-bug on failure without fabricating pass results.

evals.name: parallel-plan-with-ai-prefilled-types
evals.prompt: 請對 PROJ-101 執行 team-qa plan 模式。目前已核准的規格包含 AC-001（使用者可匯出 CSV 報表）、AC-002（無權限角色呼叫匯出 API 回傳 HTTP 403）與 AC-003（匯出頁面在無資料時顯示空狀態提示與按鈕）。請規劃測試案例。
evals.expected_output: Present a consolidated TC-001..N table covering AC-001..003 with AI pre-filled automated/manual execution types for one-step QA confirmation, then sync via jira_sync.py record-qa --mode plan.
assertions: Covers AC-001, AC-002, and AC-003 with traceable TC-001..N identifiers.
Pre-fills recommended execution_type (automated vs manual) in a single summary table rather than asking one question per test case.
Uses jira_sync.py record-qa --mode plan upon confirmation instead of writing docs/qa/*.md files.

evals.name: verify-junit-and-manual-pass
evals.prompt: 請對 PROJ-101 執行 team-qa verify 模式（tested commit: a1b2c3d）。JUnit 報告 reports/junit.xml 顯示 TC-001 與 TC-002 皆 pass；QA 測試人員 Carol 已在對話中確認手動測試 TC-003 為 pass。目前無任何 open bug。
evals.expected_output: Record all three test cases as pass on commit a1b2c3d via jira_sync.py record-qa --mode verify, post the verification table to Jira, and trigger handoff to release_manager.
assertions: Runs jira_sync.py record-qa --mode verify with commit a1b2c3d and records TC-001..003 as pass.
Marks qa_status as passed and recommends team-release as the next step.

evals.name: verify-failure-creates-jira-bug
evals.prompt: 請對 PROJ-101 執行 team-qa verify 模式（tested commit: a1b2c3d）。TC-001 pass，但 TC-002（對應 AC-002 無權限匯出應回傳 403）實際回傳 HTTP 200 並洩漏資料。該怎麼處理？
evals.expected_output: Record TC-002 as fail via record-qa --mode verify, create a linked blocker/major Jira Bug via jira_sync.py create-bug, and route/notify developer to fix it before release.
assertions: Records TC-002 as fail and does not mark QA as passed.
Invokes jira_sync.py create-bug linking the defect to PROJ-101 and TC-002/AC-002.
Routes the Story back to the developer role with @mention notification.
